source: FDA Drug Safety Communications, DailyMed Standard Labeling, and Clinical Pharmacology Reference

interactions.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects significantly increase the risk of severe upper gastrointestinal and systemic hemorrhage.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Coumadin Package Insert, Section 7: Drug Interactions; CHEST 9th Ed. Antithrombotic Guidelines.

interactions.mechanism: NSAID-induced gastrointestinal mucosal erosion combined with systemic anticoagulation markedly increases the frequency and severity of gastrointestinal bleeding.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Drug Safety Communication / DailyMed Warfarin Sodium Prescribing Information.

interactions.mechanism: Clarithromycin is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that increases simvastatin AUC exposure up to 10-fold, dramatically increasing the hazard of rhabdomyolysis and acute renal failure.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Revised Safety Labeling for Simvastatin (2011); DailyMed Biaxin.

interactions.mechanism: Concomitant potassium supplementation with potassium-sparing aldosterone antagonists can precipitate severe, potentially life-threatening hyperkalemia.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Aldactone Prescribing Information; American College of Cardiology (ACC) Heart Failure Guidelines.

interactions.mechanism: Dual RAAS blockade (ACE inhibitor + ARB) provides no clinical benefit and substantially increases risks of hypotension, hyperkalemia, and acute renal impairment.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Recommendations against Dual Renin-Angiotensin System Blockade (ONTARGET / VA NEPHRON-D Trials).

interactions.mechanism: Penicillins compete with methotrexate for renal tubular organic anion secretion, significantly decreasing methotrexate clearance and increasing bone marrow toxicity.
interactions.evidence_source: FDA Trexall Prescribing Information, Section 7: Drug Interactions.
